hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.py|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.pyi) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check --fix --unfixable F401 --exit-zero --force-exclude --quiet "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --force-exclude --quiet "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
